name: City of Lost Hope
source:
Welcome to the City of Lost Hope. You play as Jaron Mathis, a Private Investigator who recently left the Sector 3 Security in Lost Hope. Unravel the mystery that surrounds his past and dictate his future.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=10395]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到失落希望之城。你将扮演杰伦·马西斯，一名刚刚离开失落希望城第三区治安局的私家侦探。揭开笼罩他过去的谜团，亲手决定他的未来。

[译自 [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=10395]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
